sentences.japanese: 影に驚いてしまいました。
sentences.english: I was taken aback at the shadow.

sentences.japanese: 影でこそこそせず面と向かって彼にそれを言いたまえ。
sentences.english: Say it to his face, not behind his back.

sentences.japanese: 雲が影を落とすと夜よりも暗くなる。
sentences.english: Clouds cast a shadow blacker than the night.

sentences.japanese: 噂をすれば影、キャシーが来たわ。
sentences.english: Speak of the devil, here comes Kathy.
